compliance_dates_check.name: compliance_dates_check
compliance_dates_check.value: "compliance_documents"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "compliance_documents"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "compliance_documents"."valid_until" >= "compliance_documents"."valid_from"

counterparties_kpp_check.name: counterparties_kpp_check
counterparties_kpp_check.value: "counterparties"."kpp" IS NULL OR ("counterparties"."kpp" ~ '^[0-9]{9}$' AND "counterparties"."inn" IS NOT NULL AND length("counterparties"."inn") = 10)

photo_binding_target_check.name: photo_binding_target_check
photo_binding_target_check.value: ("product_photo_bindings"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_photo_bindings"."variant_id" IS NULL) OR ("product_photo_bindings"."product_id" IS NULL AND "product_photo_bindings"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_photo_bindings"."color" IS NULL)

products_manufacturer_article_uidx.name: products_manufacturer_article_uidx
products_manufacturer_article_uidx.where: "products"."manufacturer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."manufacturer_article" IS NOT NULL

inventory_count_snapshot_check.name: inventory_count_snapshot_check
inventory_count_snapshot_check.value: NOT "inventory_count_items"."expected" OR ("inventory_count_items"."expected_state" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_count_items"."expected_movement_revision" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_actor_check.name: inventory_actor_check
inventory_actor_check.value: ("inventory_operations"."actor_kind" = 'USER' AND "inventory_operations"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inventory_operations"."actor_kind" IN ('SYSTEM', 'IMPORT') AND "inventory_operations"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)

inventory_reason_check.name: inventory_reason_check
inventory_reason_check.value: "inventory_operations"."kind" NOT IN ('CORRECTION', 'LOSS', 'DISPOSE', 'DEFECT') OR length(btrim("inventory_operations"."reason")) > 0 AND "inventory_operations"."reason" IS NOT NULL

reservation_end_check.name: reservation_end_check
reservation_end_check.value: ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_reservations"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at" >= "inventory_reservations"."reserved_at")

order_items_mapping_check.name: order_items_mapping_check
order_items_mapping_check.value: ("order_items"."mapping_status" = 'REQUIRED' AND "order_items"."variant_id" IS NULL) OR ("order_items"."mapping_status" = 'VERIFIED' AND "order_items"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL)

shipment_handover_check.name: shipment_handover_check
shipment_handover_check.value: "shipments"."status" NOT IN ('HANDED_OVER', 'DELIVERED') OR ("shipments"."handed_over_at" IS NOT NULL AND "shipments"."handover_source" IS NOT NULL)

shipment_delivery_check.name: shipment_delivery_check
shipment_delivery_check.value: "shipments"."delivered_at" IS NULL OR ("shipments"."handed_over_at" IS NOT NULL AND "shipments"."delivered_at" >= "shipments"."handed_over_at")

chz_sale_cycle_check.name: chz_sale_cycle_check
chz_sale_cycle_check.value: "chz_operations"."action" NOT IN ('WITHDRAW', 'RETURN') OR "chz_operations"."sale_cycle_id" IS NOT NULL
